say:1:1622426001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我就知道您一定会来！

say:2:1622426002:1.text: I couldn't shake off Professor Hepler's words, I was tossing and turning all night.
say:2:1622426002:1.source_cn: 我一整晚都在想赫普老师的话，还有那些候鸟。
say:2:1622426002:1.male: I couldn't shake off Professor Hepler's words, I was tossing and turning all night.
say:2:1622426002:1.female: I couldn't shake off Professor Hepler's words, I was tossing and turning all night.

say:3:1622426003:1.text: I know he has a point, but... they're so badly hurt.
say:3:1622426003:1.source_cn: 虽然赫普老师说得有道理，但……但那些候鸟伤得那么重。
say:3:1622426003:1.male: I know he has a point, but... they're so badly hurt.
say:3:1622426003:1.female: I know he has a point, but... they're so badly hurt.

say:4:1622426004:1.text: Could we go see the flock again? Just to confirm they're fine.
say:4:1622426004:1.source_cn: 我还是放心不下它们，我们再去看看情况，好吗？就只是……看看。
say:4:1622426004:1.male: Could we go see the flock again? Just to confirm they're fine.
say:4:1622426004:1.female: Could we go see the flock again? Just to confirm they're fine.

say:6:1622426006:1.source_cn: 感谢您，梅林大人！那我们现在就出发吧。

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 走吧，我也同样担心那些候鸟

say:8:1622426005:1.text: Just this once, Magister Merlin. Please.
say:8:1622426005:1.source_cn: 就这一次，梅林大人……求您了。
